I sent Dana her answer in a direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

That number comes from Dana's own post in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. She first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't see the signed amendment because no Quarrendon account files are available to her, so I pointed her to June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, in case she wants to check the number before the QBR.

A seat count isn't a finance figure and Dana is on the account's team, so no approval was needed.
